intro: "The Windshapers" is a quest in which Illaya Amberwind introduces the player to the Windshapers and their spiritual mission. Tasked with reconnecting with the wind spirits, the order strives to protect Zephras and ensure the survival of the Shen'dorei amidst threats within Skywall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift.
Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I think you now understand how important the mission of the Windshapers is. Every soul who commands the skysight is of vital importance if we hope to establish dialogue with the spirits of the winds once again.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and the uncertainty of our safety here in Skywall, it is our responsibility as Windshapers to use our gifts to save our home and ensure that the Shen'dorei can survive these trying times.
